# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 101 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 101 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_101_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — The Window Is Still Open

**1** "I understand now, Lord," I said. "But can those who have already repented still be fitted into the tower?" **2** "Yes," he said — "if they repent and shed the influence of those wicked women, and if the names of the good virgins are restored to them, so that they take on those names as their own." **3** "And when will those rejected stones be fitted in?" I asked. **4** "When they repent," he said. **5** "But if they don't repent soon, they won't make it into the tower. The window for entry is only open while construction is still underway." **6** "Can they repent, Lord?" I asked. **7** "They can — but if the tower is finished before they do, there will be no place for them. There simply won't be room." **8** "Lord, may I ask one more thing?" "Go ahead," he said. **9** "Can the truly terrible sinners — if they repent — still have a place in the tower?" **10** "Yes," he said, "if they genuinely repent and abandon their wicked ways. But they won't be in the prime positions — they'll be in the lower, less significant spots. Still, if they repent before the tower is complete, they will be in it." **11** "And if someone repents after completion?" "They will be shut out of the tower. Only the Lord knows whether any such person can still enter God's kingdom." **12** "But now that you've told us, Lord, we'll make sure to repent wholeheartedly before the tower is done!" He laughed and said, "You're absolutely right to be glad about this — and what you've said is true."

---

*PNEUMA emphasizes the urgency and accessibility of the repentance window, rendering the Shepherd's pastoral invitation in direct contemporary terms.*
